verdicts.title: Singular del Pezzo fibrations and birational rigidity
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: A known conjecture of Grinenko in birational geometry asserts that a Mori fibre space with the structure of del Pezzo fibration of low degree is birationally rigid if and only if its anticanonical class is an interior point in the cone of mobile divisors. verdicts.title: Birational automorphism groups of projective varieties of Picard number two
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We slightly extend a result of Oguiso on birational or automorphism groups (resp. of Lazić - Peternell on Morrison-Kawamata cone conjecture) from Calabi-Yau manifolds of Picard number two to arbitrary singular varieties X (resp. to klt Calabi-Yau pairs in broad sense) of Picard number two. When X has only klt singularities and is not a complex torus, we show that either Aut(X) is almost cyclic, or it has only finitely many connected components.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract discusses birational automorphism groups of projective varieties of Picard number two and Calabi-Yau pairs, with no mention of CNF formulas, SAT, clause tree width, or minimal rank correlations. It shares only the broad 'birational geometry' vocabulary without engaging the specific conjecture.

verdicts.title: Monotone Boolean Functions, Feasibility/Infeasibility, LP-type problems and MaxCon
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: This paper outlines connections between Monotone Boolean Functions, LP-Type problems and the Maximum Consensus Problem.
